children: The benchmark indices closed the session on September 1 with moderate losses, while market breadth continued to favour the bears. About 2,093 shares declined, compared with 1,131 that advanced on the NSE. Consolidation is likely to continue until the indices make a sustained move above their short-term moving averages. Here are some short-term trading ideas to consider:
Amol Athawale, VP Technical Research at Kotak Securities
Oil and Natural Gas Corporation | CMP: Rs 236.45

Post its declining trend, ONGC reversed from its important support zone. The stock has formed rounding bottom chart pattern on the daily scale, and it is in a steady up move. In addition, momentum indicators are also indicating strong possibility of fresh uptrend rally from the current levels.
For the positional traders, as long as the stock is trading above Rs 227, the bullish texture is likely to continue. Above which, the stock could move up to Rs 252.

After a short-term correction, Infosys has formed a promising reversal pattern near the 50-day SMA (Simple Moving Average). Currently, the stock is trading near the 20-day SMA and has also formed a bullish candle on the daily charts.

We believe that Rs 1,115 would act as a key support zone for traders. Above this level, the uptrend could continue towards Rs 1,240. However, below Rs 1,115, the sentiment could change. In that case, traders may prefer to exit their long positions.

Post its downward trend, Cipla has entered an accumulation phase, moving within a defined range on the daily chart. Recent bullish activity suggests improving strength and rising buying interest. A breakout from the range appears likely in near term, offering a favourable risk-reward opportunity from current levels.

For positional traders, Rs 1,370 is a crucial level to watch. Sustaining above this mark could confirm an uptrend and drive the stock toward Rs 1,525. However, below Rs 1,370 uptrend would become vulnerable.
Ashish Kyal, Founder and CEO of Waves Strategy Advisors

Alembic Pharmaceuticals is consolidating within a Symmetrical Triangle pattern since July 16, 2026. The stock on August 31 took support of the 50-period EMA and have reversed sharply from it. In the previous trading session, the stock was up by more than 1 percent and closed near upper converging line.

Along with that, post bullish crossover in MACD Indicator there is formation of green histograms above the zero line, which is acting as a double confirmation. As per wave perspective, currently wave 3 of primary wave (3) is ongoing on the upside. For now, a break above Rs 850 is required for bullish momentum to continue for a move towards Rs 910 or higher, while the nearest support is around Rs 820 levels.

In the previous session, HCL Technologies has shown a strong move of almost 3 percent post days of consolidation and was also one of the top contributors in Nifty IT index yesterday. Also, prices are probably trading within the final stages of the cup and handle pattern. Any break above the Rs 1,380 level can confirm pattern breakout.

Along with that, the stock is following the 69-period Time cycle which recently got completed on August 14 and is now approaching the prior swing high of Rs 1,380 a further move above the same can turn the cycle on the buy side and can lead prices higher towards Rs 1,430 followed by Rs 1,475 level with key support being around the Rs 1,325 level.

Since June 22, Caplin Point Laboratories was trading in a small range of Rs 2,380–2,700, indicating a phase of accumulation. In the previous session, stock surged nearly 8 percent and made a fresh life time high of Rs 2,750 despite weakness in major broader indices highlighting outperformance by the stock.

The stock has also witnessed its highest volume since May 14 adding confirmation to the breakout. This breakout indicates renewed buying interest. A further move above the prior session high of Rs 2,750 can push prices higher towards new all-time high level of Rs 2,850 followed by Rs 2,950 with key support being around the Rs 2,635 level.

title: Trade Spotlight: How should you trade ONGC, Infosys, Alembic Pharma, HCL Technologies, Caplin Point Labs, and others on September 2?
